_about: Java (Fabric / Mojang names) to Horizon. Keys starting with _ are comments. Hook names come from horizon-rust/horizon native-hooks.json (hooks version 1). Entries marked approximate are educated guesses: check them against Horizon's source, or let `match` suggest better ones.

hooks._about: Horizon's native hook points (crates/horizon-client/src/game/native_hooks.rs, NATIVE_HOOKS_API 2). bindings are what a helper gets, as horizon-rust/horizon-mods' Coords HUD binds them; api = the NATIVE_HOOKS_API that added the hook.

tick.when: once per tick, in every Game (check game.native_window())

hud.when: while the HUD is drawn, after the minimap

key.when: a key or mouse button down or up, by vanilla name

command.when: a chat command, without its slash

zoom.when: when the zoom is worked out

settings_click.when: a click on a mod's settings page

panel_event.when: clicks, searches and keys over item panels

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/event/lif.note: The Fabric API layer (jfabricapi.rs) runs START_CLIENT_TICK, then the level ticks (START/END_LEVEL_TICK, while in a world), then END_CLIENT_TICK, from Horizon's tick hook, in the window's Game only.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/event/lifecycle/.note: The tick hook runs in every Game, the server's too: run server logic only when `!self.native_window()`.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/networkin.note: The Fabric API layer runs JOIN on the window's first tick with a player after none, DISCONNECT on the first tick without one after.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/keybindin.note: Horizon's key hook receives the press; the binding itself becomes a mod setting.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/command/v.note: The Fabric API layer's command engine runs the Brigadier tree: literals, integer/long/float/double/bool/string arguments with bounds, executes; requires and suggests are left out.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/command/v2/Comma.note: Server commands. Horizon's command hook is client-side.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/rendering.note: The frame hook is not inside world rendering; drawing in the 3D world has no hook yet.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/event/lif.note: CLIENT_STARTED: the Fabric API layer runs it on the window's first frame. CLIENT_STOPPING has no hook in Horizon a46ce68 (c9d474d has native_world_lifecycle).

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/client/screen/v1.note: No screen hook in Horizon yet.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/event/player/Use.note: No interaction hook yet: needs a raw target in Horizon's game code.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/event/player/Att.note: No interaction hook yet: needs a raw target in Horizon's game code.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/event/player/Use.note: No interaction hook yet: needs a raw target in Horizon's game code.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/event/player/Pla.note: No block-break hook yet: needs a raw target in Horizon's game code.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/networking/v1/Pa.note: Horizon speaks the vanilla protocol; custom packets aren't supported.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/object/builder/v.note: Block entities aren't supported in Horizon mods yet.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/itemgroup/v1/Ite.note: Creative tab entries: carried as data where horizon-port-pack can.

net/fabricmc/fabric/api/registry/FuelReg.note: Fuel values: no data-driven equivalent known yet.

methods._about: owner#member (Mojang names). hook = fits a Horizon hook point; api = what a native mod writes instead, with the helpers native_hooks.rs gives it (self is the Game the hook runs on); rust = a Horizon function path; status content = handled by horizon-port-pack. confidence checked = read in Horizon's source (nightly a46ce68).

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft#tick.note: Also runs in the server's Game: check native_window().

net/minecraft/client/gui/Gui#render.note: After the minimap, not under F1.

net/minecraft/client/KeyboardHandler#key.note: Down and up, by vanilla key name; repeats left out.

net/minecraft/client/MouseHandler#onScro.note: While playing; set claimed to keep the steps from the hotbar.

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft#getInstan.note: Hooks are methods on Game: self is what Minecraft.getInstance() gave.

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft#player.note: Option<NativePlayer>: x, y, z, yaw, pitch, dimension only.

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft#font.note: native_text and native_text_width use the game's font.

net/minecraft/client/Minecraft#screen.note: native_playing is true with nothing over the world.

net/minecraft/client/gui/GuiGraphics#dra.note: Only in the hud hook, which gives batch.

net/minecraft/client/gui/GuiGraphics#fil.note: Vanilla takes two corners; Horizon takes x, y, width, height.

net/minecraft/client/player/LocalPlayer#.note: Whether the sneak key is held: no crouch state is exposed to mods.
A chat line; the action-bar form has no helper.

net/minecraft/client/KeyMapping#<init>.note: The player's chosen key for the mod's key name, e.g. key.keyboard.h.

net/minecraft/client/KeyMapping#consumeC.api: key == self.native_mod_key(..) && pressed, in the key hook
net/minecraft/client/KeyMapping#consumeC.note: Horizon gives presses as key hook calls, not a queue.

net/minecraft/client/KeyMapping#isDown.api: self.native_mapping(name) for vanilla keys; track key hook presses for the mod's own

net/minecraft/core/Registry#register.note: Block/item registration: horizon-port-pack carries it as a content mod.

net/minecraft/core/Registry#registerForH.note: Registration: carried as a content mod.

net/minecraft/core/registries/BuiltInReg.note: Registration: carried as a content mod.
Registration: carried as a content mod.

net/minecraft/world/level/block/Block#<i.note: A block's properties become its content-mod JSON (template, hardness, light, sounds).

net/minecraft/world/item/Item#<init>.note: An item's properties become its content-mod JSON.

parents._about: Vanilla superclasses (26.x Mojang names), so `match` can find a method under the class that declares it: Horizon documents LocalPlayer's setSprinting as LivingEntity.setSprinting.

net/minecraft/world/level/block/Block.note: A plain block becomes a content-mod block copying a vanilla template. Overridden behaviour methods need native code.

net/minecraft/world/item/Item.note: A plain item becomes a content-mod item. Overridden behaviour (use, hurtEnemy...) needs native code.

net/minecraft/world/level/block/entity/B.note: Block entities aren't supported in Horizon mods yet.

net/minecraft/world/entity/Entity.note: New entities aren't supported in Horizon mods yet.

net/minecraft/client/gui/screens/Screen.note: No general screen hook; simple option pages can use the settings hook.

mixinKinds._about: Mixin injector (optionally @At value and :shift) to a horizon-mixins 0.6 kind, from horizon-mixins' docs/spongepowered-feature-gaps.md. kind null = no counterpart yet. call = the kind selects a call inside the target, which must be mapped too. bridge = a [[bridge]], not an [[injection]].

Inject@RETURN.note: Horizon's RETURN runs at every normal exit and passes the return value on.

Inject@TAIL.note: Horizon has no TAIL: RETURN runs at every exit, early ones too.

Inject@INVOKE.note: Only whole statements, plain let initializers and block tails can be selected.

Inject.note: FIELD, NEW, JUMP and CONSTANT points have no horizon-mixins counterpart yet.

ModifyConstant.note: Selects an exact Rust literal: pick it in the target function.

ModifyVariable.note: Selects a Rust local by name: pick it in the target function.

ModifyExpressionValue.note: Selects an exact Rust expression: pick it in the target function.

WrapWithCondition.note: Call `original` only when the condition holds.

Redirect@INVOKE.note: A redirect is a WRAP_OPERATION that doesn't call `original`.

Redirect.note: Field, array and constructor redirects have no horizon-mixins counterpart yet.

Overwrite.note: Exclusive: no other mod can hook this function.

Accessor.note: A [[bridge]] GET (SET for a setter) on the Rust struct's field.

Invoker.note: A [[bridge]] INVOKE of the Rust method.
